crossRefs.note: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.
Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac,
but Abraham gave gifts to the sons of Abraham’s concubines. While he still lived, he sent them away from Isaac his son…
